evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback is defined as a rollback you do not have — matched clause structure opposing 'not rehearsed' against 'do not actually have.'
A compressed formula naming a recurring organizational practice — the noun-phrase packs cadence, system, and activity into a single recurring label.
